title: The context changes the design

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: We said CarePath should help Maya feel oriented and in control. I tested the appointment offer at my desk. It works.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: Where is Maya when she opens it?

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: On a train, between meetings. She has about ninety seconds. Ah. That's not my desk.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: Today we'll test the same task in different contexts. The screen may stay the same while the conditions for success change.

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: Her connection drops just before she confirms. She comes back. Does the page tell her whether the first tap went through?

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: It doesn't. She might tap twice or give up. What does she need?

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: Saved state and an honest status. And a concise message she can understand at a glance.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: Now George opens the same offer using magnification. He sees only part of the page at once.

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: If the meaning depends on two things being side by side, he misses it. We need structure that reflows, strong contrast, and labels that make sense without their position.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: Aisha shares a family phone. Would you put the clinic name on the lock screen?

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: No. A privacy-safe notice, then a secure way to resume. Same appointment, different social risk.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: And Priya, the receptionist, is answering calls while two systems show different referral states.

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: She needs to know where a status came from and which record she's changing. An interruption must not send her back to the wrong patient.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: So what belongs in a context scenario?

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: Who is acting, their real goal, when and where it happens, device or assistive technology, time and privacy constraints, and what failure costs.

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: No. We look for a flow robust across variation, with another route where needed. But a short response deadline is a policy problem; responsive CSS can't fix it.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: Exactly. In the next lesson we'll follow the service machinery behind that visible moment.
